title: RAG or fine-tuning for fast-changing documentation
prompt: Should we fine-tune a model or use RAG for our product-documentation Q&A bot? We have about 3,000 help articles that change weekly, and customers ask questions in English, German and Japanese.

criteria.text: Recommends retrieval (RAG) rather than fine-tuning for weekly-changing knowledge, and explains why.
Recommends starting with the simplest approach that works (a prompted model plus retrieval) and adding complexity such as fine-tuning only if evaluations show it is needed.
Says the decision should be validated on an evaluation set covering all three languages.
Addresses retrieval-specific risks: stale or wrong documents, citations, and answering 'not found' when sources do not support an answer.
Mentions comparing options on cost per completed task or latency, or recording the decision with triggers for re-evaluation.
